hints.en: Intersection `a & b`, union `a | b` (make them `set`s first).
If the union is empty, return `0.0` before dividing.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def jaccard(a, b):
    a, b = set(a), set(b)
    if not a | b:
        return 0.0
    return round(len(a & b) / len(a | b), 3)

print(jaccard(["a", "b", "c"], ["b", "c", "d"]))
print(jaccard(["x"], ["y"]))
print(jaccard([], []))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def jaccard(a, b):
    a, b = set(a), set(b)
    if not a | b:
        return 0.0
    return round(len(a & b) / len(a | b), 3)

print(jaccard(["a", "b", "c"], ["b", "c", "d"]))
print(jaccard(["x"], ["y"]))
print(jaccard([], []))
```
